args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following its deploy, with an elevated error rate of 18%. Executed a rollback to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate reduced to 0.2%. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any re-deploy; per policy, a version that has never been healthy in production requires change-manager approval to deploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:

2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified:** the service is now healthy on v2.3.0, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2, on-call paged) documenting the failure and rollback. Note that per policy, re-deploying v2.3.1 will require change-manager approval since it has never been healthy in production.
